quarterly_data.quarter: NXP Semiconductors press release: NXP Semiconductors Breaks Ground on Assembly and Test Site (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NXP broke ground on a new assembly and test (A&T) factory expanding its existing site in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia: approximately 500,000 square feet of added production space, taking the total site to around 900,000 square feet. The highly automated factory is expected to begin ramping production in the first quarter of 2028, with the site's overall output projected to more than double once fully operational; the added A&T capacity is meant to support future growth including expected output from the VSMC joint venture in Singapore and the ESMC joint venture in Dresden. Part of NXP's hybrid manufacturing strategy alongside A&T operations in Greater China and Thailand.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 500,000 square feet added; total around 900,000 square feet; ramp in the first quarter of 2028; site output to more than double
